cards.pergunta: Which TCP port is used by SSH?

Which TCP port is used by SSH?

A. 21
B. 22
C. 23
D. 80
cards.resposta:
Correct answer:
B. 22
Explicação detalhada
Conceito-chave

SSH utiliza o porto TCP 22.

Por que está correta

SSH é um protocolo de segurança que opera em um porto específico para estabelecer conexões criptografadas. O uso do porto 22 permite que o cliente se conecte ao servidor e estabeleça uma sessão segura para administração remota. Em contraste, Telnet usa o porto 23, mas não oferece criptografia, o que torna o uso do porto 22 essencial para a segurança do SSH.

Evidência na fonte

SSH uses TCP port 22. The client connects to the server listening on TCP 22 and establishes an encrypted session for remote administration. Telnet uses TCP 23 and does not provide this encryption.

results.raw: [{"id_conceito":"conceito_1","pergunta":"On a broadcast OSPF network, which interface priority makes a router ineligible for DR election?","resposta":"A. 0","tags":["ospf","dr-election","priority"]}]

cards.pergunta: On a broadcast OSPF network, which interface priority makes a router ineligible for DR election?

On a broadcast OSPF network, which interface priority makes a router ineligible for DR election?

A. 0
B. 1
C. 100
D. 255
cards.resposta:
Correct answer:
A. 0
Explicação detalhada
Conceito-chave

A priority of 0 makes a router ineligible for DR election in OSPF.

Por que está correta

In OSPF, router priority determines eligibility for DR (Designated Router) and BDR (Backup Designated Router) roles. A priority of 0 means the router is not considered a candidate for these roles. Higher priority values (1-255) make routers eligible, with the highest priority router becoming DR. If there is a tie, the router with the highest Router ID is selected. The election is non-preemptive, meaning a new higher-priority router does not replace the current DR automatically.

Evidência na fonte

On an OSPF broadcast segment, an interface priority of 0 makes a router ineligible to become DR or BDR. Among eligible candidates, higher priority wins; Router ID breaks ties. Election is non-preemptive: a newly arriving higher-priority router does not automatically replace the current DR.

results.raw: [{"id_conceito":"conceito_1","pergunta":"O que é selecionado para o endereço 10.20.30.8 entre as rotas 10.20.0.0/16 via OSPF e 10.20.30.0/24 via RIP?","resposta":"RIP /24","tags":["roteamento","IPv4","rotas"]}]}

cards.pergunta: O que é selecionado para o endereço 10.20.30.8 entre as rotas 10.20.0.0/16 via OSPF e 10.20.30.0/24 via RIP?

Two installed IPv4 routes match a destination: 10.20.0.0/16 via OSPF and 10.20.30.0/24 via RIP. Which route is used for 10.20.30.8?

A. OSPF /16
B. RIP /24
cards.resposta:
Correct answer:
B. RIP /24
Explicação detalhada
Conceito-chave

Forwarding selects the longest matching prefix for route selection

Por que está correta

When multiple routes match a destination, the longest prefix takes precedence. The /24 route (10.20.30.0/24) is more specific than the /16 route (10.20.0.0/16). During forwarding, the /24 route is chosen because it matches the destination IP 10.20.30.8 more precisely. Administrative distance is used during route installation, not during forwarding, so it does not affect the selection of the longest prefix.

Evidência na fonte

Forwarding selects the longest matching prefix among installed routes. 10.20.30.8 matches both 10.20.0.0/16 and 10.20.30.0/24, so /24 is selected.

results.raw: [{"id_conceito":"conceito_1","pergunta":"Which command forces a switch interface into trunk mode?","resposta":"switchport mode trunk","tags":["networking","switching","trunking"]}]

cards.pergunta: Which command forces a switch interface into trunk mode?

Which command forces a switch interface into trunk mode?

A. switchport mode access
B. switchport mode trunk
cards.resposta:
Correct answer:
B. switchport mode trunk
Explicação detalhada
Conceito-chave

O comando switchport mode trunk define um interface de switch como trunk.

Por que está correta

O comando switchport mode trunk configura um interface de Ethernet para operar em modo trunk, permitindo a passagem de múltiplos VLANs. Quando aplicado, o interface é capaz de transportar dados de várias VLANs em uma única conexão. O uso de show interfaces trunk permite verificar o status do trunk e as VLANs permitidas. O modo trunk é diferente do modo access, que apenas suporta uma VLAN específica.

Evidência na fonte

The command switchport mode trunk sets an Ethernet switch interface to trunk mode, allowing multiple VLANs on that link.
